hiredDate.description: Date when the employee got hired

deactivationDate.description: Date when the employee got deactivated

securityGroups.description: List of Security Groups associated with the employee, specified as a list of Security Groups IDs

supervisorId.description: ID of the employee’s supervisor. The value is a supervisor ID, look up the supervisor’s employee ID using the GET supervisors endpoint.

primaryDepartmentId.description: ID of the primary department associated with the employee

dateTimeCreated.description: Date and time of employee creation

dateTimeModified.description: Date and time of the last employee data modification

dateTimeDeleted.description: Datetime when the employee account was last deactivated

employeeTypeId.description: Identifier of the employee's employee type

salaryIdentifier.description: Salary code identifier of the employee

userName.description: Username of the employee - must be an e-mail. Not set for draft employees.

cellPhone.description: Cell phone number associated with the employee

cellPhoneWithoutCountryPrefix.description:
Cell phone number with the country dialing prefix removed. When the country prefix cannot be
resolved, this contains the same value as Planday.OpenApi.HR.Api.V1.Models.Output.EmployeeOutputBase.CellPhone.

street1.description: Address 1 information of the employee's address

street2.description: Address 2 information of the employee's address

zip.description: Zip code of the employee's address

phone.description: Phone number associated with the employee (not frequently used)

phoneWithoutCountryPrefix.description:
Phone number with the country dialing prefix removed. When the country prefix cannot be
resolved, this contains the same value as Planday.OpenApi.HR.Api.V1.Models.Output.EmployeeOutputBase.Phone.

email.description: Primary email address of the employee. Not set for draft employees.

departments.description: List of Departments associated with the employee, specified as a list of Department IDs

employeeGroups.description: List of Employee Groups associated with the employee, specified as a list of Employee Groups IDs

isPublic.description: Whether the employee's data is publicly visible to other employees

terminationTypeId.description: ID of the termination type selected on deactivation, if any. Present also for employees with a future dismissal date.

terminationTypeName.description: Name of the termination type selected on deactivation, if any

deactivationReason.description: Free-text reason/comment supplied on deactivation, if any

bankAccount.description: Bank account associated with the employee

ssn.description: Social security number of the employee

cellPhoneCountryPrefix.description: Country prefix of the cell phone number

cellPhoneCountryCode.description: Country code of the cell phone number. Follows ISO 3155. alpha-2 codes.

phoneCountryPrefix.description: Country prefix of the phone number

phoneCountryCode.description: Country code of the phone number. Follows ISO 3155. alpha-2 codes.
